rows.name: Luau Bombs
rows.notes: Instagram handle @luau_bombs comes from the Hawaii Farm Bureau vendor page. That page lists Wednesday Honolulu Farmers' Market, Saturday KCC Farmers' Market and Sunday Mililani Farmers' Market, but the page itself looks dated. Plenty of Aloha (https://plentyofaloha.com/) lists Luau Bombs as a Windward Mall Market vendor, and the HFBF Mililani market page was updated recently, so I marked it active. A 2020 blog (Hawaii Mom Blog) mentioned an older handle, @chefwhyweezy, which I did not use. No Facebook page or website found.

rows.name: Minasa Hawaii
rows.notes: The website URL is given by a July 2024 food blog and by business listings; I did not open the site itself. The brick-and-mortar restaurant is at 94-866 Moloalo St Ste D12, Waipahu (Tropicana Square), after starting as an outdoor pop-up. That is in the Ewa/leeward area, not Kapolei proper. A Facebook page named 'Minasa' (Ewa Beach, 68 likes, https://www.facebook.com/p/Minasa-100068019670607/) may be related, but I could not tie it to this business, so it is left null. No Instagram handle found. Third-party delivery listings exist, but I did not treat them as official order links. still_active is null because I found no recent first-party confirmation.

rows.name: Mossy Mokes
rows.notes: The Facebook page describes sea moss infusions owned and operated by Misty Sommo, with a Kailua location and wholesale email sales@mossymokes.com. The email domain suggests mossymokes.com, but I could not confirm a website, so it is left null. Plenty of Aloha lists Mossy Mokes among its market vendors. The Hawaii Food & Wine Festival entrepreneur page (hawaiifoodandwinefestival.com) features 'Mossy Mokes - Misty' with sea moss gels and beverages, which supports it being active. No Instagram handle confirmed.

rows.name: Pukoa Imports
rows.notes: No source found for a business called 'Pukoa Imports'. Similar names turned up (Pukoa Studios, a Native Hawaiian kapa studio in Chinatown, pukoastudios.com; Pukoa Organics; Pukoa Pacific Pearls), but none could be tied to this vendor, so all fields are null.

rows.name: Silverspring
rows.notes: 'Silver Spring Hawaii' is a Honolulu gift and handcrafted-goods seller (wallets, pouches, tote bags, backpacks, jewelry). It has a Big Cartel shop and a website listed in a business directory. The match to this vendor is unverified because the seed has no product description, and I did not open the website. No Instagram, Facebook or market schedule found. Activity unconfirmed.

rows.name: Suppa Golden
rows.notes: Listed on the Plenty of Aloha organizer site as a Windward Mall Market vendor. That page does not show a date, so 'active' rests on the listing alone. No social accounts or website found. Unrelated results for 'Suppa' (a beer, a staffing firm) were ignored.

rows.name: Yume-ya
rows.notes: The only match is an old Japanese-language directory listing for Yume-ya (夢屋) at 1016E Kapahulu Ave, Honolulu, categorized as a hobby shop. The listing is about 9 years old, and I could not confirm it is the same vendor. 'Yajima-Ya' results are a different business. No official presence found.

rows.name: 1132 Cafe
rows.notes: The website is given in a business directory entry (sameAs 1132cafe.com), and the Chamber of Commerce Hawaii member page links to a website; I did not open the site. It is a downtown Honolulu cafe and caterer on Bishop St; the chamber page lists 1164 Bishop St Ste 119, while other listings say 1132 Bishop St, so the address is inconsistent. An older directory listing said it sold at the Fort Street Mall Market on Tuesdays and Fridays, 10:30am-1:30pm, but that is not a current first-party source, so no schedule URL is given. The chamber listing is about 15 months old. No social accounts found.

rows.name: Ali'i Fish Market
rows.notes: The business's own site shows 2320 South King Street, Suite H, Honolulu, open daily 10am-3pm with holiday hours varying. The Instagram URL comes from a Nov 2024 Great Eats Hawaii blog post that links it; I did not open the account. It is a fixed storefront, so there is no market schedule. One page on the site (/da-alii) has stale schema data showing a different address, 1481 S King St Suite 108. No Facebook found.

rows.name: Bebot Filipino Food
rows.notes: The seed says Windward, but the only match is Bebot's Filipino Fast Food in Waipahu (inside Don Quijote on Farrington Hwy; Facebook https://www.facebook.com/bebots808/; it has also had a swap meet stall). The name and location don't match closely enough to be sure it is the same vendor, so the account is left null. Needs manual verification.

rows.name: Carlito's Carnitas
rows.notes: The site is 'Carlitos Carnitas of Hawaii'. It says Carl and Terri brought the business to O‘ahu in 2025 and lists a menu of carnitas plates, tacos and burritos. The site nav has a 'Find Us' section, but I did not see its contents, so no schedule URL is given. No Instagram or Facebook found.

rows.name: Chubby Fries & Wings
rows.notes: The Instagram handle @chubby_fries_and_wings is given in Star-Advertiser features from Jan 2026 and Jan 2024; I did not open the account. It is a family-run food truck/pop-up owned by Sharon Pegollo, ordered in person only. The 2024 article listed stops at Wai Kai on Thursdays, What The Truck? at Waikele on the first Friday, and Pearlridge's Village Market on Saturdays; these may have changed. I could not confirm where it posts a current schedule. Also on Eventeny as a Kapolei-based vendor: https://www.eventeny.com/company/?c=398272.

rows.name: Corn Onoz Hawaii
rows.notes: Star-Advertiser articles (Oct 2023 and Mar 2026) give the handle @corn_onoz_hawaii and say to follow it for location updates; I did not open the account. The pop-up opened its first storefront in Pearl City (719 Kamehameha Hwy, Unit A103) around March 8, 2026, per Aloha State Daily and Hoodline. An earlier Kapolei location is reported closed. No website or Facebook found.

rows.name: Curry Guru Hawaii
rows.notes: The Instagram bio lists Sunday at Kailua Farmers Market, the last Wednesday of the month at Night Market Central, and Saturday at Kaka‘ako at 8am. The snapshot date is unknown, so check the account for current stops. A KHON2 feature (about 2.5 years old) also says to check Instagram for market locations. No Facebook or website found.

rows.name: Da 'Cuterie
rows.notes: I ran out of search calls before I could look this vendor up, so nothing was found or verified. Needs a manual search.
